decoder: position-aware side(u,v); budgets max; integer sigma

columns_legend.RAW_HIT: leaves with at least one certB hypothesis bundle
columns_legend.CERT_REPLAYED: synthesized certB multipliers pass verify_cert at tau
columns_legend.REJECTED: bundle exists but no boundary topology replayed

boundary_topologies.note: each boundary slot independently realized by fan_e (endpoint fan equality + qs baseline) or cap_e (angle-cap <= pi-lam on the span arc, exactly one cell); fan and cap at the same end double-count and are never combined

certs_s6.note: n=2 regime already proved (SecondStripHigh); regression value

witness_files: witnesses/{n4_high,n4_low,s6}.jsonl — one record per replayed leaf: chain, L, cut, per-piece sides/splits, D_j/H0/Hright gap ranges + qs baselines + cap sources, orig ids, exact rational multipliers, C-alpha*delta<=0 form, premise_map
independent_reverify: 45/45 sampled witnesses pass verify_cert from file

transfer_family.T1: fan_u + tri(v,u,w) with apex pattern (D,C,D): dirArc(u;v,w)=dirArc(v;u,w)+dirArc(w;v,u)
transfer_family.T2: fan_u1 + detour pair sharing anchor dirArc(w;a,x): negative image arc absorbed by rle cap

caveat: 100% bounded-corpus coverage is EMPIRICAL; the universal selection theorem (every legal over-capacity configuration admits a certificate) remains open.
